$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-26-batch-p/2026-10-26-batch-p.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

source.operator_quote: K1 any of K2 yes to both

decisions.question: A unit keyed with several specific uses applies when the lot has any of them
decisions.recommendation: K1 'any of': the specific-use check (evaluate.mjs:601, today the first listed token only) becomes a one-line .some over the unit's specific-use tokens, so a lot with any listed use is in scope (e.g. an exception keyed [nursing_home, retirement_home, religious_residence] applies to a lot with only retirement_home). Built together with the first producer of lot.uses; today none exists (UNSET_LOT_INPUTS), so 0 cells. Lock G1-e flags the day a producer appears.

decisions.question: The permission answer also discloses the M-159(3) set-asides of the G1 use clauses and the M-158(1) caveat of the 3 G2 conversion clauses
decisions.recommendation: K2 'both' (the operator chose the card's 'both' alternative over its recommendation of (2) only, knowing the card's stated cost of up to 44 sentences per lot for (1)): (1) the M-159(3) sentence for the G1 use-clause set-asides and (2) the M-158(1) caveat for the 3 G2 conversion clauses (e.g. 'if this is an existing building being converted, 600.60.40(3)(D) applies') are disclosed on the permission. Built as a G5-shaped add-on under its own PLAN: recomputed on read (CHAT-80.QP form, no column), closed phrases as data (R-BZ). The add-on PLAN must design (1)'s presentation so the answer stays readable (e.g. grouped into one line). Does not gate night D: the text is recomputed on read and no permission word moves.
